query: What are the names and ratings of the movies with ratings higher or equal to 9.5 with more than 1000 votes?
sql_query: SELECT t.original_title , r.rating FROM titles t INNER JOIN ratings r ON r.title_id = t.title_id WHERE r.rating >= 9.5 AND r.votes > 1000 AND t."type" = 'movie'
